title: Another Word for "Change": 3 Better Words #shorts
description:
Another word for "change" in English. Don't just say "Change". Here are three better words:
• Adjust. (to change a little)
• Transform. (to change it fully)
• Replace. (to put a new one in)

Want more words for change? Watch the full lesson on this channel: Another Word For Change
